company.name: Second
company.shortDescription: Automated migrations and upgrades for every codebase
company.description: Second is a company that specializes in providing developer tools, software, and web applications. Their main product, Second Step, is an automated code migration tool for developers. This tool is designed to streamline the process of code migration, making it more efficient and less prone to errors. In addition to this, Second also offers a range of other software development services and solutions. Their offerings are designed to support developers in their work, helping them to create high-quality, reliable software and web applications.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based platform that automates code migrations and upgrades by connecting to code repositories, generating change plans, executing transformations, and delivering pull requests for review.
productsAndServices.name: Automated Codebase Migration and Upgrade Platform

productsAndServices.description: A service that scans codebases to identify security vulnerabilities, performance issues, redundancies, and code quality problems, generating reports and automated fixes via pull requests.
productsAndServices.name: Codebase Intelligence and Issue Detection

productsAndServices.description: Second Best is a forthcoming beer brand created by BrewDog founder James Watt as part of a new brewing business.
